area_resource: SKY130 non-SRAM standard-cell area must be at most 2.0 mm^2 after the canonical OpenROAD-flow stage used for signoff reporting.
SRAM macros/blackboxes must be enumerated separately by bank, width, depth, port model, and estimated macro area source.
The append-only area frontier ledger must bind each architecture/RTL delta to source hashes, constraint hashes, non-SRAM area, Fmax, cycle impact, and remaining reserve.
correctness: Every supported operation and full-workload trace must be bit-exact against the independent fixed-point reference for the frozen numerical behavior.
Reset, error, interrupt, backpressure, and descriptor-corner tests must pass with no known mismatches.
RTL must have no unresolved X-propagation in architecturally visible outputs after reset release.
performance: Report sustained end-to-end prefill and decode tokens/s at 100 MHz using cycle-accurate traces for every required memory-bandwidth point.
Report cycles/token, external bytes/token, on-chip SRAM accesses/token, and stall breakdown for every benchmark trace.
Do not claim a tokens/s target beyond measured evidence; optimize for the maximum sustained value subject to correctness, quality, frequency, and area constraints.
power: Report leakage, internal, switching, and total power for the canonical benchmark VCD/SAIF at the primary 100 MHz SKY130 corner.
No pass/fail power cap is operator-approved at definition time; power evidence is still required before PPA, prototype, benchmark, or signoff claims.
provenance: Every verification, PPA, power, DRC/LVS/antenna, FPGA, and benchmark claim must link to immutable raw output and source/configuration hashes.
Missing public tool support is recorded as a blocker or limitation, never as a passed check.
quality: The W4A8 reference must be compared with the public BF16 Qwen2.5-0.5B reference using the same tokenizer and prompts.
Acceptance target: perplexity must be no more than 1.05x BF16 on WikiText-2 raw validation and the frozen C4-en 512-prompt slice.
Acceptance target: normalized accuracy drop must be no more than 2.0 percentage points averaged over the frozen open lm-eval task set selected in WORKLOAD.md.
If these targets are not met, quality remains unmet until the operator explicitly approves a replacement target.
timing: Primary SKY130 timing floor is at least 100 MHz.
Nangate45 and ASAP7 timing reports are comparative only and must carry academic/predictive labels.

manager_transition.reason: Verification cannot advance: the candidate independent-oracle gate is unmet, the required baseline companion hash is missing, and a prohibited candidate entrypoint was already invoked. The exact-once verification path is therefore terminally unusable. Roll back to RTL for the identified RMSNorm reference/RTL numerical-contract repair; architecture, interfaces, targets, and downstream locks remain unchanged.

baseline_fairness_policy.comparison_rule: Only same-workload, same-quantization, same-memory-boundary executable measurements count as fair open-baseline comparisons. Commercial and market references are context only.
open_baselines: NVDLA-small where the workload adaptation is executable and documented
VTA or other open accelerator only if it can execute a documented subset without unsupported extrapolation

excluded_claims: measured silicon frequency, power, yield, or reliability
commercial-process equivalence for Nangate45 or ASAP7
private PDK, licensed IP, or proprietary memory compiler dependence
external DRAM, LPDDR, PCIe, AXI, or other physical-interface PHY implementation in the first delivery
training, fine-tuning, multi-batch serving, speculative decoding, beam search, tokenizer implementation, or application sampling policy
included_claims: synthesizable digital RTL IP for the defined accelerator subsystem
deterministic command stream generation for the frozen workload
cycle-accurate RTL verification against the independent reference
lint, assertions/formal where tractable, reset checks, and coverage evidence
DFT/scan intent and public-tool scan checks where supported
public-tool synthesis, floorplan, PDN, placement, CTS, routing, extraction, STA, power, DRC, LVS, and antenna evidence where supported
SKY130 primary PPA plus comparative Nangate45 and ASAP7 OpenROAD-flow PPA with platform labels
fair open-baseline comparison protocol when executable evidence is available

baseline_reproducibility.requirement: A fresh zero-carry/disabled-mechanism replay must reproduce the frozen baseline bit-for-bit for ordered layer traces and final outputs using the identical model checkpoint, dataset slices, seed, integer metadata, software revision, hooks, and invocation; any mismatch blocks candidate evaluation.

mechanism.final_output_propagation: Apply the remaining carried correction exactly once to the final hidden-state input before final RMSNorm and lm_head.
mechanism.layer_boundary_propagation: At each transformer-block output, compute the signed fixed-point difference between the wide post-MLP accumulator and the dequantized emitted activation, carry that quantization error as a sideband into the next block, and add it exactly once before the next input RMSNorm.

banked_sram.macro_policy: SRAM macros are blackboxes and excluded from the 2.0 mm^2 non-SRAM standard-cell cap; wrappers, muxes, controllers, and scan logic are counted

clock_reset.cdc_policy: no internal CDC in the first IP; any future asynchronous host or memory bridge is an explicit wrapper outside the core scope
clock_reset.clocking: single synchronous accelerator clock domain for core, CSR, DMA boundary, SRAM ports, and command engine
clock_reset.reset: active-low reset input with asynchronous assertion and synchronous deassertion at the accelerator boundary

command_descriptor.completion: in-order completion per submitted chain with explicit error code and interrupt policy

external_memory_stream.backpressure: any channel may deassert ready without data loss; benchmark sweeps effective bytes/cycle by injecting ready stalls
external_memory_stream.handshake: independent ready/valid request, write-data, read-data, and response channels

accumulator_format.partial_sum_equivalence: tiled partial sums must be exactly equivalent to a single signed_int32 accumulation before requantization

weight_format.packing: two weights per byte, low nibble first
weight_format.scale_derivation: maximum absolute BF16 weight across the complete output-channel reduction divided by 7
weight_format.scale_granularity: one symmetric scale per output channel across the complete projection reduction; 128-element blocks do not introduce additional scales

kv_cache.key_format: signed_int8 with two copies of the static layer0 K Scale32 record in the candidate metadata beat
kv_cache.storage_location: external memory with optional on-chip SRAM tiling
kv_cache.value_format: signed_int8 with two copies of the static layer0 V Scale32 record in the candidate metadata beat

requantization.saturation: clip to destination integer range after rounding

rope.input_format: signed_int8 projection output with one static producer scale per Q tensor and one per K tensor
rope.pre_rotation_internal_format: signed_int8 payload with scalar producer scale

rounding.tie_policy: ties to even least-significant retained bit

not_supported: sliding-window attention mode because the frozen config disables it
dynamic model shape changes after synthesis
hard DRAM PHY, cache-coherent host fabric, or proprietary NoC attachment
floating-point RTL datapaths for the primary W4A8 workload
supported: command descriptor fetch, decode, dependency tracking, and completion
external-memory read/write streaming DMA with backpressure
banked on-chip SRAM load/store through abstract macro/blackbox ports
int4-weight by int8-activation tiled matrix-vector and matrix-matrix projections
Q, K, V, output, gate, up, down, and lm-head projections
grouped-query attention with 14 query heads and 2 KV heads
KV-cache read, append, and external spill/fill
